text:
This was by far the worst dental experience I've ever had, and I absolutely do not recommend this clinic to anyone.

First, the assistant took the wrong x-ray for my tooth, and I had to go through the process again due to clear miscommunication between the dentist and the assistant. That should’ve been my first red flag.

During the filling procedure, the dentist accidentally poked my tongue with a sharp tool, causing a visible hole in my tongue and bleeding. To make matters worse, teeth cleaning was extremely painful and unbearable, and I experienced significant bleeding after it. Both the dentist and the assistant seem inexperienced. The assistant placed the saliva ejector so far back that it triggered my gag reflex throughout the entire procedure — it was extremely uncomfortable and borderline unbearable.

After the appointment, I voiced my concerns to the receptionist, who casually dismissed everything, saying “some bleeding is normal, the wound in your tongue will be healed” The dentist didn’t bother to come back to check on the injury they caused, not even an apology! I was in a rush so I paid for the full amount and left. But later I noticed my tongue was swollen and in so much pain that I couldn’t eat for several days. I had to go to the hospital for another check up at my own expense due to the incident.

I emailed their customer service several times to report what happened and received no response — not even an acknowledgment. Shockingly, it wasn’t until my friend (who had booked her appointment at the same clinic) canceled hers and mentioned my experience in her email that the clinic finally responded after 2 days.

This clinic showed a complete lack of professionalism, communication, and basic patient care. I will never return and strongly advise others to avoid this place at all costs.
